(() => {if(document.querySelector('#hv-tab-Music').getAttribute('aria-selected')!=='true')throw new Error('Forward swipe failed');if(Math.abs(new DOMMatrix(getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('[class*=screenTrack]')).transform).m41+130)>.1)throw new Error('Did not snap');return 'Home to Music swipe and tab synchronization pass';})()
(() => {if(document.querySelector('#hv-tab-Clock').getAttribute('aria-selected')!=='true')throw new Error('Second swipe failed');return 'Music to Clock swipe pass';})()
(() => {if(document.querySelector('#hv-tab-Clock').getAttribute('aria-selected')!=='true')throw new Error('Wrapped past edge');return 'Last-screen edge resistance and snap back pass';})()
(() => {if(document.querySelector('#hv-tab-Home').getAttribute('aria-selected')!=='true')throw new Error('Reverse swipe failed');return 'Reverse swipe returns to Home';})()

(() => {if(document.querySelector('[data-lights]').dataset.lights!=='on')throw new Error('Drag clicked lights');if(document.querySelector('#hv-tab-Music').getAttribute('aria-selected')!=='true')throw new Error('Drag on button failed');return 'Swipe starting on button works without clicking it';})()

(() => {if(document.querySelector('[data-lights]').dataset.lights!=='off'||!document.querySelector('#hv-panel-Home').textContent.includes('22°'))throw new Error('Normal clicks broken');return 'Normal light and temperature taps still work';})()
